title: Change an undergraduate major
description: Follow the published undergraduate procedure through the College Advising Unit.
descriptionAr: اتبع إجراء البكالوريوس المنشور عبر وحدة الإرشاد الأكاديمي في الكلية.
verificationNote: Use the current official page for portal labels, applicable term and eligibility. This checklist does not submit a request or verify your private university record. Changing major is normally permitted once under the cited procedure; approval is individual.
verificationNoteAr: تحقق من المسميات والفصل والأهلية في الصفحة الرسمية الحالية. لا ترسل هذه القائمة الطلب ولا تتحقق من سجلك الجامعي الخاص.
scopeNote: Changing major is normally permitted once under the cited procedure; approval is individual.

steps.title: Check the procedure’s scope
steps.instruction: Check the procedure’s scope: it applies to undergraduates excluding Medicine and Health Sciences; the published policy is effective 2018 and later supersession is not certified here.
steps.instructionAr: تحقق من النطاق: يخص الإجراء البكالوريوس باستثناء الطب والعلوم الصحية؛ والسياسة المنشورة نافذة منذ 2018 ولم يُعتمد هنا عدم استبدالها لاحقاً.

steps.title: Submit the official request
steps.instruction: Submit the official request: use your College Advising Unit after at least one month from classes starting; the department reviews and the Dean or designee decides.
steps.instructionAr: قدّم الطلب الرسمي: عبر وحدة الإرشاد الأكاديمي بعد شهر على الأقل من بدء الدراسة؛ يراجعه القسم ويقرر العميد أو من يفوضه.

steps.title: For an internal college transfer
steps.instruction: For an internal college transfer: check the intended term’s published calendar window before applying.
steps.instructionAr: للتحويل الداخلي بين الكليات: تحقق من فترة التقديم المنشورة للفصل المطلوب في التقويم.

sources.title: UAEU Undergraduate Registration and Enrollment Policy
sources.sourceVersion: Effective 2018-08-12; review due 2021-09-01; no supersession certification
sources.sourceSection: Undergraduate registration procedures; scoped to non-CMHS undergraduates
sources.evidenceText: Published effective-2018 undergraduate policy excludes the College of Medicine and Health Sciences; later supersession not established. AE-03 procedure for declaring/changing a major: official request through the College Advising Unit after at least one month from classes starting; academic department reviews, Dean or designee decides. Normally one major change. No fixed processing time stated.

sources.title: UAEU Academic Calendar
sources.evidenceText: Academic calendar internal-college-transfer windows: 16–27 November 2026 for Fall 2026; 19–30 April 2027 for Spring 2027. These dates are not a universal major-change rule or another term's deadline.
